recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core work is needed for Bundle.identifier unless a future work group decision changes document identity semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-12162 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for DSTU2. It asked to add Bundle.identifier 0..1 as a persistent, version-specific identifier for document Bundles because Bundle.id can change as a document moves between servers.
initial_application: The request was applied by svn revisions 10242/10243, visible in git as 88db4c7805d907c61bc750d3694adeaadb784063, which changed source/documents.html from Bundle.id to Bundle.identifier for document identity.
additional_context: FHIR-12054 is the same-change-family seed that also asked for document Bundle identifier/date/version semantics. source/fhir.ini lists Bundle as an active resource, and current documents.html says Bundle.identifier is the mandatory document identifier.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because Bundle.identifier exists as a persistent Identifier, maps to ClinicalDocument.id, and is described in the active document narrative.

related_jiras.note: Overlapping issue that also asked for document Bundle identifier/date/version semantics and is satisfied in part by Bundle.identifier.
